name: dmx-@WORLD@
description: Demaurex documentation, world @WORLD@: search and read the documents you are allowed to see, through the central dmx server.

server_url.title: dmx server
server_url.description: Address of the central dmx server (leave the default unless IT says otherwise).

allowed_hosts.title: File servers documents may be opened from
allowed_hosts.description: Comma-separated names of the file servers the relay may open documents from. Enter each server name exactly as it appears in the document paths (\NAME\share). A server that is not listed is refused; an empty list refuses every network path.
